title: He Didn't Give Him Money. He Gave Him a Chance ❤️
theme: kindness / giving a chance instead of money / pay it forward
idea_source: reelmimic remake (original story: The Warm Cup)
caption:
He didn't give him money. He gave him a chance ❤️

Two dollars in a cup. One thermos, fifty cups and a sign that said HOT COCOA $1. A year later, that corner had a name.

Would you have done the same? Send this to someone with a big heart.

youtube.title: He Didn't Give Him Money… He Gave Him a Chance ❤️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Every morning he walked past the same man with the same sign: ANYTHING HELPS. One freezing night, instead of a coin, he came back with a thermos, fifty cups and a box of cocoa. One year later, that corner had a name. ❤️

Sometimes the best help isn't money. It's a chance.
